headline: 本周影剧：热片领跑，幻视任务首播
summary: 电影方面，《人性本兽》《社交清算》等本周热作吸睛；剧集方面，《降世神通：七净土》《幻视任务》首播，《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》热播，待映片《沙丘3》《复仇者联盟5》受期待。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《人性本兽》《另一个妈咪》《社交清算》《花匠刺客》《致命录像带：混音带》本周在列。
industryHighlights.en: Film hits this week include Human Nature Beast, Another Mommy, Social Reckoning, The Gardener Assassin, and V/H/S: Mixtape.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《降世神通：七净土》《幻视任务》本周开播；《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》《魔女嘉莉》热播。
industryHighlights.en: New premieres: Avatar: Seven Havens and Vision Quest launch this week; Jack Reacher, Green Lantern Corps, and Carrie are hot.

industryHighlights.text: 待映片单：《猫鼬》《复仇者联盟5》《街头霸王》《泥面人》《沙丘3》等待映。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films include Mongoose, Avengers 5, Street Fighter, Clayface, and Dune 3.

headlineEn: This Week in Film & TV: Hits Lead, Vision Quest Debuts
summaryEn: In film, this week's hits include Human Nature Beast and Social Reckoning; on TV, Avatar: Seven Havens and Vision Quest premiere, while Jack Reacher and Green Lantern Corps are hot, with Dune 3 and Avengers 5 awaited.
